# picomatch is vulnerable to ReDoS through single-branch repeated extglobs, and
# the advisory lists every release as affected: no patched version exists as of
# 2026-11-18. Vellum reaches picomatch only through build and test tooling
# (vite, vitest, @electron-forge, node-gyp); the shipped app does not match
# user-supplied glob patterns with it. The only automatic fixes are major
# downgrades of those tools (vite 7->6, vitest 4->3, @electron-forge 8->7),
# which still ship picomatch. Remove this exception as soon as picomatch
# publishes a fix, and recheck by expiry. The Dependency review step in
# .github/workflows/ci.yml allows the same advisory (allow-ghsas); remove both.
# https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-fc5q-39xc-vjpf
